rationale: run captures the configured command, working directory, raw output bytes, exit information and version probes with before/after snapshots; snapshot and Execution::validate enforce roots, directory membership, profile/runner identity and generated/symlink exclusions. status chooses the latest finish time and conservatively handles tied failures or stale receipts. The separately retained spec-checks.json selects lean-assumptions; scripts/check-assumptions.sh rebuilds with --wfail before running CheckAxioms.lean, whose explicit #print axioms commands identify the reported theorems. This supports the final paragraph without confusing an assumptions report with semantic correspondence.
limitations: The implementation is not hermetic or authenticated; restored-between-snapshot mutations, ambient dependencies and excluded generated files remain outside the receipt. I inspected source and test assertions; command execution results belong to separate receipts.
